target_vs_target_contradictions.title: Law 108 / Law 215 (dev DB = per-developer Neon branch) vs TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md 2 (dev DB = local Postgres 16; 'Never point dev at Neon')
target_vs_target_contradictions.severity: highest - it gates the entire local-environment target

side_A.text: | 108 | Technology | SQLite in dev | Per-developer Neon branch is the dev database. SQLite only for pure unit tests that do not exercise RLS, JSONB, schemas, or row locking. | Fast unit tests without full DB fidelity. |

| 215 | Deployment | Docker Compose | Local dev: cache, backend, frontend, celery, beat, mailhog (optional). Database is Neon (remote). | Mirrors production minus the remote database. No local Postgres container. |
| 210 | Testing | Test environment | APP_ENV=test. CSRF/rate disabled. SQLite for pure unit tests; Neon branch for integration. | Optimized for speed; matches dev workflow. |

side_B.text: | PostgreSQL (local) | 16 | Dev | Primary OLTP database for local development; 15 domain schemas; RLS for multi-tenant isolation. | Faster inner loop than cloud DB; offline-capable; no egress/cost; disposable `dropdb/createdb` cycle. | Always in local development. Run via Docker Compose (`postgres:16-alpine`). Never point dev at Neon. |
| Alembic | 1.19.1+ | All | ... | Always. Must use a direct (non-pooled) connection string. In dev, use the local Postgres DSN. Never auto-migrate on web replica boot. |

| Docker Compose | 2.40.0+ | Dev | Local service orchestration (PostgreSQL 16, Valkey, backend, frontend, Celery, Beat). | Mirrors production with local Postgres instead of Neon. | Use for local dev. Includes a local Postgres 16 container. |
| `POSTGRES_DB` | No | No | PostgreSQL database name. | Dev | Local database name for development. | Matches docker-compose service. |
| `POSTGRES_USER` | No | No | PostgreSQL username. | Dev | Local DB user for development. | Matches docker-compose service. |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | No | No | PostgreSQL password. | Dev | Local DB password for development. | Matches docker-compose service. |

side_C_technology_stack_contradicts_itse.text: | Neon CLI | 4.14.3+ | Dev/CI | Neon branch management (create/delete, connection strings). | Branch-per-dev and branch-per-PR workflow. | Use in dev and CI. Renamed from `neonctl` - the `neon` binary is canonical. |

| `DATABASE_URL` | No | Prod | Neon PostgreSQL connection string (direct, non-pooled for Alembic). | All | Primary DB connection for all domain services. | Neon branch-per-env; non-pooled for migrations. | Always. Use direct DSN for Alembic; pooled for app runtime. |

target_vs_target_contradictions.title: TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md documents DEFAULT_COUNTRY twice with contradictory defaults (US vs AE)
target_vs_target_contradictions.severity: high - it decides the RLS fallback country for every request

side_A.text: | `DEFAULT_COUNTRY` | No | No | Default country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; default `US`). | All | Fallback country when detection fails or no session context. | Required for RLS context and localization before user country is known. | Set to primary market country in production. |

side_B.text: | `DEFAULT_COUNTRY` | No | No | Default country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; default `AE`). | All | Fallback country when detection fails or no session context. | Required for RLS context and localization before user country is known. | Set to primary market country in production. |

target_vs_target_contradictions.note: Both rows are in the SAME table and are otherwise byte-identical apart from the default value. The row at :392 is the one the audit register cites as canonical (_audit/07_CONTRADICTIONS.md:245). backend/config.py:289 has already been set to "US", i.e. to whichever side the remediator assumed.
target_vs_target_contradictions.impact: Law 5 (ARCH:531) makes country_code the RLS scope axis; the fallback decides the RLS session context when detection fails, so the wrong default silently scopes a tenant's queries to the wrong country.
target_vs_target_contradictions.non_authoritative_observation: The repo's surrounding signals point at AE (root .env targets a UAE-region host; TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md:503 sets DEFAULT_CURRENCY to OMR). Offered as information only - I am not resolving this.
